dct_description_sm: Appears in: Untitled atlas containing maps of Africa (1803)
Part of a series of four double-paged linen backed coastal map. Inset: Table Bay and False Bay.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0227, p. 254
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0227.
